parsed.summary: The patch initializes the variable 'kern' to avoid an UnboundLocalError, but it does not address the root cause of the issue and may introduce unintended behavior.

issues.description: The patch introduces a default value for 'kern' without understanding the context in which 'kern' is used. This may lead to unexpected behavior or introduce new bugs.
The patch does not include any tests to verify that the change resolves the issue and does not introduce new problems.
